svg.text: ARDOR REV C INTEGRATED DA7212 AUDIO + CONTROL HAT
Rev C — onboard 24-bit codec, fail-safe outputs, protected guitar/line/amp, isolated MIDI, expression ADC
3. ONBOARD DA7212 → STEREO LINE + MONO GUITAR AMP
7. INTEGRATED DA7212 CODEC / I2S / CLOCK / 1.8 V
DA7212: 12.288 MHz master clock, 1.8 V analogue rail, 3.3 V I/O; VDD_SP and microphone paths unused.
GPIO10 HIGH closes K1/K2 only after codec clocks and bias are stable; GPIO10 defaults LOW at reset.
Use isolated-bushing audio jacks. Bond CHASSIS at J9; fit R31 only after hum/EMC verification.
U1 is one OPA4377AIPWR in TSSOP-14; place 100nF directly at pins 4 and 11.
MIDI cable side is isolated: never join MIDI_TIP/RING/SHIELD to AGND/DGND. No extra I2C pull-ups fitted.
Rev C J2/J3 are DNI bring-up headers. DA7212 input divider provides active-pickup headroom; compensate in codec gain.
